rationale: CNV-PLT-011 defines an accessible assurance path; the identity proofing vendor is not selected, so whether the chosen flow meets WCAG 2.2 accessible authentication is unverified.
acceptance_criteria: Assistive technology test records show completion of each authentication path.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Inbound migration specification
statement: Unbound SHALL specify inbound migration from a predecessor administrator: source data mapping, identifier preservation and aliases, import of issued acknowledgments as original artifacts, ACH authorizations and donor preferences, re-verification of legacy grantee flags, parallel run with a single authoritative system at any time, and a signed migration reconciliation of balances, units and history before cutover.
rationale: CNV-EXP-002 requires import of full fund history with a reconciliation report and UNB-RCN-WF-009 requires tied-out opening balances, but no requirement specifies mapping, parallel run, authorization transfer or legacy flag re-verification. ANS-PRT-004 records that predecessor exports may be unobtainable.
acceptance_criteria: A migration specification exists with acceptance tests.
A dry run on a synthetic five-year ledger reconciles to the source with zero unexplained differences.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: medium (one to six person-months or $10,000 to $50,000 external spend).

title: Published export schema and independent reconstruction test
statement: Unbound SHALL publish a versioned export schema and data dictionary available before contract signature, provide self-service full and incremental export during the term at no charge, and demonstrate annually that an independent party can reconstruct balances and statuses from an export without Unbound software.
rationale: CNV-ENT-002 requires a full reconciled export and an export manifest covering every class; RR-UNB-TEN-016-r1 (signed manifest, independent verification) is unvalidated, deferred and amended. No requirement publishes a schema or tests independent reconstruction (C12).
acceptance_criteria: The schema is published with version history.
An independent reconstruction test reproduces trial balances per fund and period.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: medium (one to six person-months or $10,000 to $50,000 external spend).

title: Termination assistance and in-flight items
statement: The standard contract SHALL commit to a transition period at unchanged service levels, export API availability throughout notice and transition, no suspension of data access during disputes, defined handling of pending recommendations, approved unpaid grants, recurring series and holds, unwinding of TPSP roles with the sponsor's bank, and the fees, if any, for transition assistance.
rationale: CNV-ENT-002 covers records custody, read-only access for 90 days and backup expiry, but not transition service levels, dispute access or in-flight item handling.
acceptance_criteria: The contract schedule covers each element.
An exit dry run exercises in-flight items.
verification_method: Contract review plus exit dry run.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Insolvency protection: escrow, wind-down plan and reserve
statement: Echelon SHALL offer a SaaS escrow arrangement for Unbound (source, build and deployment materials, infrastructure code, schemas and runbooks, excluding secrets) verified at least annually by build and deployment test, a written wind-down plan, and a funded reserve sized to complete an orderly transition for all customers.
rationale: CNV-GOV-009 covers escrow for Echelon dependencies used by Unbound, not escrow for customers. ANS-ESC-001 and ANS-TRM-003 are unknown. The PolyForm Noncommercial license on most components means a successor operator may lack rights to run escrowed code without a commercial license (DD-UNB-VEND-003).
acceptance_criteria: An escrow agreement and verification report exist.
A wind-down plan and reserve evidence exist.
verification_method: Document review plus escrow verification report.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: medium (one to six person-months or $10,000 to $50,000 external spend). Recurring: escrow fees and reserve funding.

title: Scheduled exports to sponsor-owned storage
statement: Unbound SHALL offer scheduled full and incremental exports, with manifests and control totals, delivered to sponsor-owned storage so that each sponsor holds a current copy of its records independent of Echelon.
rationale: No requirement provides continuous customer-held copies; this is the cheapest mitigation for vendor insolvency.
acceptance_criteria: A scheduled export delivers to a test bucket owned by a separate account with a verifiable manifest.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Exit drill
statement: Unbound SHALL run an exit drill at least annually on a synthetic sponsor (notice, export, independent verification, in-flight handling, read-only period, backup expiry and destruction certificate) and offer the drill report to sponsors.
rationale: CNV-ENT-002 defines exit outcomes but no requirement tests them; C11 asks for an observed exit drill.
acceptance_criteria: A drill report exists within 12 months with timeline and findings.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Subprocessor register and notice in release 1
statement: The tenant-specific subprocessor register and 30-day change notice in UNB-XIN-SAS-011 SHALL be in release 1 scope rather than deferred, with an objection process and AI providers listed.
rationale: Verified: UNB-XIN-SAS-011 has release scope Deferred. Subprocessor lists are expected at first contract, and one large-bank supplier standard requires per-subprocessor prior written consent (batch 1).
acceptance_criteria: A published register is generated from the vendor inventory.
A test subprocessor change produces notices 30 days before effect.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Critical provider selection with due diligence
statement: Before activation, Echelon SHALL select and record due diligence for each critical provider (hosting, bank or payment rail, custodian feeds, sanctions list, identity proofing, email and AI model), including assurance report review, contract term checklist, concentration and exit plan.
rationale: SOC2-013 and CNV-GOV-002 define vendor monitoring, but no bank, custodian, crypto or screening provider is selected (batch 1), so many answers depend on unknown counterparties.
acceptance_criteria: A due diligence file exists for each listed provider class.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: medium (one to six person-months or $10,000 to $50,000 external spend).

title: Commercial license and customer rights for Echelon components
statement: Before commercial availability, Echelon SHALL execute commercial licenses for every PolyForm Noncommercial component in Unbound and SHALL define customer, auditor, escrow beneficiary and successor operator rights to run and inspect those components.
rationale: CNV-GOV-009 makes an executed commercial license a gate; batch 1 notes nearly the whole stack is PolyForm Noncommercial and customer, auditor and escrow rerun rights are unaddressed.
acceptance_criteria: Executed licenses exist for each component.
The SBOM license gate passes.
The customer agreement states the rights.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: SOC 2 Type II plan tied to first production data
statement: Echelon SHALL engage a qualified CPA firm, complete a readiness assessment and begin a SOC 2 Type II observation period no later than the first production processing of real donor data, with scope covering security, availability and confidentiality and the inclusive or carve-out treatment of the hosting provider stated.
rationale: CNV-GOV-001 sets scope by actual reliance and avoids stand-alone Type 1, which suits SOC 1 but leaves no SOC 2 timing. Every assessor asks for SOC 2 Type II first; the incumbent baseline is a Type 1 (batch 1). Timing is judgment requiring owner decision; the 2027 criteria exposure draft may apply.
acceptance_criteria: An engagement letter exists.
A readiness report and observation period start date are recorded.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: high (over six person-months or over $50,000 external spend). Recurring: annual audit fees.

title: Customer and examiner access terms
statement: The contract package SHALL grant sponsors and their auditors a right to audit and examiners of regulated customers access to records, personnel and systems, with notice periods and a standard evidence pack.
rationale: CNV-GOV-001 requires right-to-audit and an evidence pack in contracts but does not address regulator access for bank customers.
acceptance_criteria: The contract package contains both rights.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Fee recomputation and ledger tie-out
statement: Each fee run SHALL be independently recomputed from the schedule version and source balances by a separate process, with differences raised as exceptions, and fees SHALL tie to the payee and the general ledger before statements publish.
rationale: CNV-FIN-002 versions schedules and requires daily computation but sets no independent recomputation; the sponsor audit matrix (C21) asks for fee and ledger tie-out evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A recomputation report shows zero unexplained differences for each run.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).

title: Retention floor consistency
statement: All Unbound requirements stating a seven-year retention floor for transaction-level financial or grant records SHALL be aligned with the ten-year release-1 floor of CNV-PLT-004, and the retention schedule SHALL be approved by each sponsor compliance owner.
rationale: Verified: REQ-X-037 to REQ-X-041, REQ-X-045 and REQ-X-048 (original, not amended) and RR-REQ-X-036-r1 state a seven-year financial floor, while CNV-PLT-004 applies a ten-year floor to all transaction-level financial and grant records in release 1 and amends only REQ-X-036. The texts are not logically incompatible (ten years satisfies a seven-year minimum), but an assessor quoting the seven-year text will state the wrong release-1 retention period.
acceptance_criteria: Each listed record states that CNV-PLT-004 governs the release-1 period, or is flagged in the DD-UNB-GOV-001 register.
cost_impact: Judgment, order of magnitude, not sourced: low (under one person-month of effort or under $10,000 external spend).
